title: LIVE PRECIPITATION
freshness: LIVE / CURRENT OBSERVATION (MRMS CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB + ECCC NA radar, 2-6 min mosaic)
noaa_source: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
product_name: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
variable: MRMS SeamlessHSR base reflectivity dBZ (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) + MRMS PrecipFlag surface type; ECCC precipitation-rate rain (mm/h)/snow (cm/h) mapped to dBZ through the ECCC 14-color class rates with the NWS Z=300R^1.4 equivalence (equal ECCC colors = equal severity = equal dBZ). One 5-75 dBZ severity scale rendered on two ramps that match the NOAA/CSU MRMS event-loop legend: Rain (green->purple) and Snow/Sleet (pale blue->purple).
units: 5-75 dBZ severity on two ramps: Rain (green->purple) and Snow/Sleet (pale blue->purple)
spatial_resolution_source: MRMS SeamlessHSR ~1km CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB composite 2-min (measured dBZ -> severity ramps; PrecipFlag snow); ECCC 1km NA composite 6-min (class severity -> estimated dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4; snow classes use the Snow/Sleet ramp); canvas 3300x1600 (0.05 deg/px)
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: ECCC wins where RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV is transparent (verified authoritative coverage); MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB) fills ECCC gaps (measured dBZ -> severity ramps; PrecipFlag snow); OPERA EU radar fills remaining non-NA gaps (Rain ramp); JMA nowcast fills Japan gaps (Rain ramp); GFS model estimates only in verified radar gaps (CSNOW/CICEP snow on the Snow/Sleet ramp); transparent elsewhere; never zero-filled.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html: Precipitation type + intensity (OBSERVED radar echo; 5-75 dBZ severity). Rain ramp: dark green (light) → green → yellow → orange → red → magenta → purple (extreme). Snow/Sleet ramp: pale blue (light) → blue → purple (heavy). Same intensity sits at the same position on both ramps. Type is observed/analysed, never inferred from color: MRMS PrecipFlag (snow class 3) inside CONUS and the regional AK/HI/CARIB domains, ECCC SfcPrecipType (snow classes) in Canada, and GFS CSNOW/CICEP for model snow/ice in verified radar gaps only. Echoes from sources that publish no type (OPERA EU, JMA) stay on the Rain ramp. No echo = transparent; GFS pixels are model estimates, never radar. GFS model estimates (not radar) use the same two ramps where no radar covers.

na_bounds.note: Authoritative common geography for the GLOBAL coverage variant of the four live gradients (wind_na, precipitation_na, cloud_cover_na, air_temperature_na). Same 0.10 deg/px grid as aurora_global. Basin + North America variants keep their existing canvases; only the former extended200 variant moves here. Areas without valid source data stay transparent.

folder_html:
LIVE PRECIPITATION

Sources: NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR hybrid-scan reflectivity composite (CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii, Caribbean; dBZ, public domain) + ECCC North American Radar Composite 1km rain (RADAR_1KM_RRAI, mm/h) / snow (RADAR_1KM_RSNO, cm/h) / precipitation type (Radar_1km_SfcPrecipType) + EUMETNET OPERA EU DBZH composite (CC BY 4.0) in remaining radar gaps + JMA Japan nowcast (attribution) in Japan gaps + NOAA GFS model estimates, same colors (public domain) in verified radar gaps only
Precedence: ECCC rain (rates -> dBZ via NWS Z=300R^1.4 onto the shared severity scale) wins everywhere its RADAR_COVERAGE_*.INV dynamic coverage is valid, including most of CONUS; ECCC snow classes (SfcPrecipType) render on the Snow/Sleet ramp; NOAA/NSSL MRMS SeamlessHSR (CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB: measured dBZ -> severity ramps, PrecipFlag class 3 -> Snow/Sleet ramp) fills ECCC gaps; OPERA EU DBZH fills remaining non-NA radar gaps on the Rain ramp (no type product); JMA nowcast intensity (mm/h classes) fills Japan gaps via Z-R equivalents on the Rain ramp (no type product); GFS model estimates (CSNOW/CICEP -> Snow/Sleet ramp, CRAIN/CFRZR -> Rain ramp) only in verified radar gaps; transparent elsewhere.
Coverage: Global Coverage
Radar note: radar echoes (MRMS CONUS + regional AK/HI/CARIB/ECCC/OPERA/JMA); GFS model estimates (not radar) in verified radar gaps, same colors
